articles.title: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup
articles.mainIdea: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Goldman Sachs and Bain Lead Investment in AI Marketing Startup. Hightouch, a platform that uses generative AI to help marketers create and manage campaigns, has raised a $150 million funding round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives’ Growth Equity division and Bain Capital Ventures, the companies said. The round, which also included TD7, the venture capital arm of adtech firm the Trade Desk, values Hightouch at $2.75 billion. The company’s most recent funding round valued it at $1.2 billion in February 2025. Related tickers mentioned: GS.
